name: Wsreset.exe
description: Used to reset Windows Store settings according to its manifest file
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: During startup, wsreset.exe checks the registry value HKCU\Software\Classes\AppX82a6gwre4fdg3bt635tn5ctqjf8msdd2\Shell\open\command for the command to run. Binary will be executed as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt being displayed to the user.
commands.usecase: Execute a binary or script as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt.

detection: wsreset.exe launching child process other than mmc.exe
Creation or modification of the registry value HKCU\Software\Classes\AppX82a6gwre4fdg3bt635tn5ctqjf8msdd2\Shell\open\command
